explanation: Establishes completeness of physical reporting queries, including distinct original positions with equal keys. Every original wanted label is realized by an in-range stored slot, so scanning the physical array does not omit a valid label.
theorem_title: Every original wanted label occurs in the physical pair array
theorem_formal_statement:
theorem ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.WantedRecordCoverage.output_complete {μ : ℕ → ℤ} {free M P h J : ℕ} {shift : ℤ} {xs : List ℤ}
    (H : _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightWantedSetup.Output μ free M (_root_.ThreeSum.LightGuardedWanted.left P xs)
      (_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightGuardedWanted.right h J) (3*xs.length) (_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightGuardedWanted.totalKeys h J) shift)
    {w : _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.RawReporting.Wanted h J (Fin xs.length)}
    (hw : w ∈ _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.RawAKeyLists.wanted M P xs h J shift) :
    ∃ slot i j, ∃ hi : i < 3*xs.length,
      slot < (μ free).toNat ∧ j < _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightGuardedWanted.totalKeys h J ∧
      μ (_root_.ThreeSum.LightWantedSetup.pairBase free (3*xs.length) (_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightGuardedWanted.totalKeys h J) M+2*slot)=(i : ℤ) ∧
      μ (_root_.ThreeSum.LightWantedSetup.pairBase free (3*xs.length) (_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightGuardedWanted.totalKeys h J) M+2*slot+1)=(j : ℤ) ∧
      _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.WantedRecordOrder.label h J i j hi=w := by sorry
theorem_natural_language_statement:
Let $\mu$ satisfy the complete wanted-setup output contract for an integer list $x$, natural moduli and local parameters $M,P,h,J$, and shift $s\in\mathbb Z$. Every original label in the corresponding wanted family is decoded from some physical pair slot below the stored count. The two cells at that slot contain indices $i<3|x|$ and $j$ below the global-key count, and their decoded label is exactly the given one.

Establishes completeness of physical reporting queries, including distinct original positions with equal keys. This is a supporting lemma in the complete deterministic integer 3SUM runtime proof.
